abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. The condition was NOT(DEFENDS_WITH_OTHER_HAND_CARD) with a nested SELF_ATTACK_POWER_GTE that DEFENDS_WITH_OTHER_HAND_CARD does not read -- a fixed power threshold standing in for a comparison against the live attack. The card asks whether any DEFENDER has {p} at least equal to the attack's, which is what DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT power_gte_attack counts.
